body: SOURCE-LEVEL SUPPORT FINDING before successor freeze. align/wire.scala MayBeImputed documents that Propositional and Entity neutral 0.5 fallbacks mean the dimension is ineligible when the recall has no predicate or specified participants. But DefaultLocalCostModel.computeCost currently sets dProp=0.5 unless both predicates exist and dEnt=0.5 when specified participants are empty; both are placed in always, eligible includes always.map(_._1), and measured is terms.keySet minus only semantic imputation. Therefore an absent predicate and absent entity comparison contribute their full weights as measured support. The published SupportAssessment cannot distinguish “question did not apply” from “measurement occurred”; the neutral price is being laundered into evidence. This is visible for AnnaFixture.blended (predicate=None), and a no-participant unit triggers both. Please disposition explicitly: either derive Propositional/Entity per-cell eligibility and intersect measured with eligible while preserving the separately ruled price, with wire coherence updated accordingly; or cite an accepted decision that these 0.5 fallbacks are genuine measurements despite the current wire contract. I have not run a competing sbt court against your mutable worktree or edited any path.
